## Country

Which country roster needs work? (e.g. `senegal`, `iceland`)

## What's off

Briefly — names sound wrong, naming convention is reversed, missing regional variety, role distribution feels weird, etc.

## Proposed change

Either describe the change in prose, or paste a replacement roster in the per-player line format:

```
1. **<Name>** — Captain · RH bat · opener
2. ...
33. ...

Coach: <Name>
Assistant coach: <Name>
```

You can also send a PR directly editing `neo_handcricket/rosters/data/<slug>.json` — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#roster-workflow).

## Cultural source / reference

If you're drawing on specific knowledge (you're from this country, or you've researched naming conventions), please mention it — context helps reviewers.
